title.name: RO_WEB Skill Core 2
title.scope: 擴充玩家職業系列技能；共通技能引用 Core 1
dataSources: 專案官方 Skill ID 與技能圖片
customRules: MC_INCCARRY 改為每級最大 HP +2%，Lv10 共 +20%
技能特效只使用 RO_WEB 自有 SkillID.png + SkillID.json
不直接使用官方 SPR / ACT
怪物、傭兵、公會、NPC、GM、測試技能不納入玩家 Skill Core
技能傷害、治療、Buff、Debuff、被動效果只允許由 data/skill_runtime Runtime Profile 執行；Skill Core 不保存舊 power/healPower/effects/passiveBonuses。

meta.scope: Expanded player jobs: Gunslinger, Ninja, Taekwon/Soul Linker and Summoner families through expanded 4th classes
meta.sharedSkillPolicy: Any Skill ID already present in CORE_1 is referenced from CORE_1 and never duplicated.
meta.visualPolicy: RO_WEB SkillID.png + SkillID.json only; no direct SPR/ACT fields
meta.formulaPolicy: RA structured metadata imported; source-code formulas explicitly marked until ported
meta.sourceWhitelist: Only skills referenced by explicitly selected player expansion job trees.
meta.descriptionPolicy: All executionEnabled skills describe current RO_WEB effects; Mado skills remain directly usable without a Mado-state requirement.
